details.report: Committed forward fix baf8686. Canonical bindings now capture immutable ReviewerPromptIdentity content evidence; settlement reuses accepted dispatch identity or the binding-owned pre-acceptance identity and never projects locators. Reviewer package contracts now distinguish thin intent from fully validated RuntimeReviewerReceiptV2, enforce report/content hashes, construction/target, outcome/report/status/refusal invariants, and project intent to runtime enrichment. Recorder uses this projection only for Reviewer and revalidates after scanning; all other equality/projection laws remain unchanged. Added completed/refused native-session and mismatch/tamper regressions plus accepted/pre-acceptance identity coverage. Verification: focused tests pass (31/31), typecheck passes, isolated-HOME full suite was run and exposed one expected snapshot fixture update; after that update its focused test passes (3/3). The same full run passed package/cold-install and isolated-pack verticals. npm pack --dry-run succeeds (93 files), build/package succeeds, and git diff --check passes. Dismissed Standards-child behavior was not changed; no report parsing, allowlists, or reruns were added.
